Title: Daily Digest
WhatItDoes: A morning summary of your inbox: high priority items, emails waiting on your reply, team items you're copied on, and updates, with marketing filtered out. It reads only your own mailbox, with your own sign-in.
HowToStart: Open Daily Digest in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams or Outlook and say "Run my daily digest". To get it every weekday, schedule that prompt once (about 5 minutes).

Title: Email Filing Assistant
WhatItDoes: Suggests the client or matter folder for emails you've already dealt with. It never moves anything on its own: you confirm every filing, and it never touches flags or categories. Optional.
HowToStart: Currently with a small pilot group. Tell us in Feedback if you'd like to try it.

Title: Closing Checklist Builder
WhatItDoes: Builds a first-draft closing checklist from the commitment letter and loan documents. One of the two leading candidates from the AI Working Group vote.
HowToStart: Not available yet. Use the 'Build a closing checklist from a commitment letter' prompt in the Prompt Library in the meantime.

Title: Deal Intake and Issues List Builder
WhatItDoes: Captures a new deal's key facts and keeps a running issues list from the email traffic. One of the two leading candidates from the AI Working Group vote.
HowToStart: Not available yet. Use the 'Turn a long email thread into an open-issues list' prompt in the meantime.
